GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 569.7 (22 Jan 47) GD
(SCAPIN - 1482)
APO 500
22 January 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Sale of Japanese Merchant Vessels
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. letter No. 168 (CM), dated 16 January 1947, subject as above, and inclosures thereto, requesting approval of sale of sixteen (16) vessels.
2. Permission is granted for the sale and transfer of title of subject vessels providing the money transfer is in accordance with Emergency Financial Measures and Amendments of the Imperial Japanese Government.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
